newsitem.title: CANADA: Imperial Oil resuming share buyback.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Oil resuming share buyback.

text.p: Imperial Oil Limited said on Tuesday it would resume its year-long share buyback of 9.2 million shares or five percent of its public float.

The normal course issuer bid, which was interrupted last summer by the Canadian oil company's C$1.4 billion, one-time stock purchase from shareholders, began on June 19 and would continue until June 18, 1997, Imperial said.
The company repurchased 140,130 of its shares before last summer's suspension.
Imperial said 69.6 percent owner Exxon Corp advised that it would continue to participate in the issuer bid to maintain its ownership level.
But Exxon added that it would review its participation from time to time and inform Imperial of any change in its intentions, Imperial said.
